programme.title: 沉默的荣耀 Tập 6
programme.desc: 根据真实历史改编，讲述吴石奉命赴台任国防部次长，暗中传递重要情报；朱枫放弃与家人团聚，只身赴台接任交通员。两人密切合作，为解放军攻克舟山群岛立下大功，却因叛徒出卖于台北牺牲，谱写壮烈一页。

programme.title: 念无双 Tập 22
programme.desc: 神魔大战后，神器"神之左手"坠入人界，狐族少年源仲获神器之力封印战鬼，自此被尊为新神。神女無雙奉命潜入狐族夺回神器，却目睹源仲遭族人排挤诬陷，决心守护他，携手对抗命运，揭开封印背后的真相。

programme.title: 念无双 Tập 23
programme.desc: 神魔大战后，神器"神之左手"坠入人界，狐族少年源仲获神器之力封印战鬼，自此被尊为新神。神女無雙奉命潜入狐族夺回神器，却目睹源仲遭族人排挤诬陷，决心守护他，携手对抗命运，揭开封印背后的真相。

programme.title: 苍兰诀【动画】 Tập 20
programme.desc: 改編自九鹭非香小说《苍兰诀》。上古魔尊东方青苍复生，灵力未复被战神九渊重伤，被迫与小仙小兰花互换灵魂。小兰花意外杀死自身仙身，两人共用一体踏上寻找新肉身的旅程。一路打闹中情愫暗生，却不知青苍另有阴谋。

programme.title: 余红旧事 Tập 19
programme.desc: 改编自班宇小说《于洪》的犯罪悬疑剧。90年代东北小城离奇命案接连发生：酒鬼冻成冰雕、壮汉惨遭断肢、地头蛇神秘失踪。看似毫无关联的"意外死亡" ，背后却牵出纠葛的人性与命运。

programme.title: 余红旧事 Tập 20

programme.desc: 吴君如、殷桃、林依晨、周冬雨、王可、邓为、王星越“七福”集结！横跨墨西哥、秘鲁、阿根廷，一路南下至世界最南端城市乌斯怀亚，在四季更迭中感受拉美热情，开启跨文化探索之旅。

programme.title: 喜事 Tập 4

programme.title: 全员加速中 2025 Tập 2

programme.title: 风味人间5·香料传奇 Tập 7
programme.desc: 《风味人间》第五季聚焦香料，讲述它们如何迁徙融合、塑造风味与地域性格。从香料看历史与文化，探索人类因欲望而起的寻香之旅，揭示香料如何改变世界与未来饮食图景。

programme.title: 兰香如故 Tập 8

programme.title: 去"湘"当有味的地方 Tập 9

programme.desc: 宝发现强出轨，在婚礼上播放他偷情画面后宣布离婚。恢复单身的两人保持友好关系，一天强竟骗宝参加换妻派对，遇上杰和丽两夫妻，各自寻欢。直到宝和杰开始交往，强才意识到自己始终在乎宝，他能挽回前妻的心吗?

programme.title: 金钱帝国:追虎擒龙
programme.desc: 集合四位影帝同台飙戏，呈现香港70年代的贪污年代。讲述香港警黑勾结，贪污巨利荼毒市民。港督成立廉政公署，两位检察官历尽千辛万苦，将权倾黑白两道的总华探长徐乐和跛豪绳之以法的故事。

programme.title: 像我这样的爱情
programme.desc: 阿妹饱受脑麻痹之苦，又因被迫接受子宫切除而受煎熬。在残疾人士亲密服务组织中，她邂逅了Ken，一段不被世俗理解的情感悄然滋长，也带领两人一同跨越偏见与界线。

programme.title: 失衡凶间之罪与杀
programme.desc: 《失衡凶间》灵异惊栗短片系列回归，三个惊吓犯罪故事，分别围绕着一名前美发广告模特儿、一位猫痴、一段护士、牙医及厨师的三角关系。结合诡异短篇剧情，描述他们执念成狂的经过，最后甚至引发暗黑人性的失衡。

programme.title: 第八个嫌疑人
programme.desc: 在一则新闻片段内出现的一个模糊身影，重新燃起了退休刑警王守月要破这宗数十年未解之案的欲望，要追捕当时获通风报讯后顺利逃脱的两名幕后主脑。一场正邪对决由此展开！

programme.title: 不日成婚2
programme.desc: 阿佳和可怡婚前关系出现分歧。另一边，灰熊又怀疑妻子红杏出墙。而当阿健的女友意外怀孕后，他陷入人生最迷茫的时候。众人最后可否化解感情上的冲突?

programme.title: 不日成婚2
programme.desc: 阿佳和可怡婚前关系出现分歧。另一边，灰熊又怀疑妻子红杏出墙。而当阿健的女友意外怀孕后，他陷入人生最迷茫的时候。众人最后可否化解感情上的冲突?

programme.title: 鬼地方
programme.desc: 电影描述三个发生在不同年代的恐怖鬼故事，当中围绕着一名孕妇，一名遭欺凌而自杀身亡的同学，及几个打开一箱旧衣服的公司员工。

programme.title: 慌心假期
programme.desc: Michele正面临婚姻破裂的危机，于是她独自到欧洲散心。 旅途中，Michele结识了日本女子Miki，二人结伴游玩后，Michele发现对方竟是自己婚姻里的第三者。

programme.title: 手卷烟
programme.desc: 金马影展口碑爆棚、由影帝林家栋领衔的黑帮电影，再现港片独特迷人风味！讲述退役华籍英军游走于几个黑帮堂口，还与南亚裔流氓住在一起，从互相利用到惺惺相惜，并在相处中重新找到自己。

programme.title: 靠近我一点
programme.desc: 等了初恋男友10年的林楚楚，最终等来的是男友和别人的婚礼。正当她对感情失去信心的时候，遇上一位婚礼策划师和一位富有男神的同时慰藉。楚楚的感情也来到了必须抉择的十字路口，最后她会如何抉择?

programme.title: 一秒钟
programme.desc: 取材自导演张艺谋早期经历，讲述被送往劳改营的平民，为看女儿的电影不惜从劳改营逃走。途中，他偶遇一名孤女，两人同样要找到那卷电影菲林，最后能否将菲林交给放映员，让电影在大屏幕播出?

programme.title: 热血燃烧
programme.desc: 由于黑警泄密，导致一名缉毒队成员在抓捕毒枭的行动中遇难。当其他队员揭开真相时，他们陷入忠诚与背叛的内心挣扎。

programme.title: 孤星计划
programme.desc: 1920年代白色恐怖时期，谍报员李一民临危受命，在组织被破坏、孤立无援的危局中，独自承担护送要员秘密撤离任务。一民途中重逢旧友，并肩共闯敌人天罗地网。

programme.title: 阴目侦信
programme.desc: 当「阴目侦信」调查恶鬼在一栋旧楼出现的案件时，发现所谓的恶鬼都是由炼鬼师亲自炼成，目的是要恐吓居民以清空楼宇作重建之用。「阴目侦信」的侦探们最后能否找到打败炼鬼师的方法?

programme.title: 七月与安生
programme.desc: 好友七月与安生在遇见了男生苏家明后，二人的友情受到考验。三人纠缠在三角关系的同時，亦改写了她們各自往后的命运。

programme.title: 冰封侠重生之门
programme.desc: 锦衣卫四大高手之一的贺英，因为遭受陷害，被其他三位高手元龙、聂虎和萨獒追捕。就在众人陷入混战中时，巨大雪崩将四人淹没冰封在雪地里。

programme.title: 曾经拥有
programme.desc: 吴少金患有阿兹海默症。然而，节目监制细姜怀疑他是个以尖酸刻薄的影评谋利的影评人。于是，细姜假扮朋友接近吴少金，却渐渐发现了他的秘密和辛酸故事。

programme.title: 异度空间
programme.desc: 当昔日的创伤令恐怖的幻象反复出现時，章昕向精神科医生罗本良求助。然而，随着章昕逐渐康复，罗本良却让自己埋藏多年的心魔释放，更被幻象所困扰。

programme.title: 西游记·女儿国
programme.desc: 女儿国女皇对唐僧一见钟情，国师却下令要处死唐僧一行人。当河神现身，女儿国同时亦陷入了危机！

programme.title: 西游记·女儿国
programme.desc: 女儿国女皇对唐僧一见钟情，国师却下令要处死唐僧一行人。当河神现身，女儿国同时亦陷入了危机！

programme.title: 阿龙
programme.desc: 阿龙与女儿相依为命，生活潦倒却依然乐观，深信好人有好报。然而一次泰国之旅，女儿惨遭拐走。信念崩塌的他为追寻线索不惜一切，暗中追查拐子集团，最终化身双手沾血的复仇者。

programme.title: 风再起时
programme.desc: 七十年代香港，廉政公署成立，决心打击警队贪污。探长磊乐和南江聯手建立警队的贪污制度，导致黑社会与警队斗争和角力。当廉政公署要通缉两位探长时，磊乐与南江只手遮天的年代亦告落幕。风再起时，香港已风云变色！

programme.title: 犀利人妻最终回：幸福男·不难
programme.desc: 安真与出轨的丈夫离婚，四年后却面临关键的抉择：究竟是回到前夫身边试着重燃昔日的爱火，还是与新欢一起踏入人生新的一页?

programme.title: 扫毒2天地对决
programme.desc: 以毒品为主，地藏和墨西哥大毒枭跨境合作，企图"毒霸"香港毒品市场；而慈善家兼金融巨子，悬赏一亿追杀最大毒贩，引起了轩然大波。这是影帝刘德华及古天乐携金马影后林嘉欣共同演出。

programme.title: 4拍4家族
programme.desc: 决心踏上国际舞台的歌手与失散多年的吉他手父亲重逢，父女二人和其他家人通过对音乐的热爱一起缔造充满爱的家庭。

programme.title: 我们一起发
programme.desc: 贾氏家族是一群聪明的台湾骗徒。他们受聘于一名诈骗高手，策划一场复杂的诈骗行动，旨在揭露一位贪污的科技大亨所经营的庞氏骗局，并从中夺取数百万元赃款。

programme.title: 无间一战
programme.desc: 故事围绕着一对兄弟。一个是贩毒集团的头目，另一个是缉毒组探员，二人不约而同卷入一场毒枭的地盘斗争中。随着弟弟作为贩毒头目的隐藏身份被揭穿后，一场无间反转的正邪交锋随即展开。

programme.title: 金玉满堂
programme.desc: 赵港生希望以厨师身份在加拿大展开新生活，于是前往满汉楼向欧兆丰学习厨艺。他将代表满汉楼参加满汉全席比赛，然而，由于厨艺尚未成熟，只能向一位厨神求助，以应对这场终极挑战。

programme.title: 寒战
programme.desc: 横扫第32届香港电影金像奖九项大奖！在警务处处长外访期间，警车被劫持，随之整个香港都陷入安全危机。于是，署理警务处长李文彬以"寒战"行动与恐怖份子展开了一场高智商的较量。

programme.title: "骗骗"喜欢你
programme.desc: 林晴朗遭爱情骗子欺骗，还背负巨额债务。为夺回金钱，她与诈骗首脑欧阳晖联手设局，却在斗智斗骗的过程中意外谱出一段浪漫情缘。

programme.title: 扎职
programme.desc: 阿霆、阿祥和阿栋在油麻地跟随四九耀文，情同手足。阿霆得罪火爆明遭毒打而记恨在心，一次借机铲除火爆明泄愤，为自己坐上龙头之位铺路，却也掀起一轮江湖血战！

programme.title: 沖天火
programme.desc: 林岭东执导，吴彦祖、张孝全、张静初、张若昀及郭采洁主演的悬疑动作电影。三大男神热血开战，上演剑拔弩张的的惊天动作戏码，在诱惑和生死面前，考验人性的善恶与复杂。

programme.title: 邪Mall
programme.desc: 当七只恶灵将荒废商场的租客化为丧尸后，影碟铺老板与女儿联同一名风水师，必须拼死抵抗丧尸的袭击，而商场也逐步陷入炼狱般的绝境。

programme.title: 邪Mall
programme.desc: 当七只恶灵将荒废商场的租客化为丧尸后，影碟铺老板与女儿联同一名风水师，必须拼死抵抗丧尸的袭击，而商场也逐步陷入炼狱般的绝境。

programme.title: 白蛇传说之法海
programme.desc: 白蛇与许仙相恋成亲后，耗损元气制药医治城中怪病，遭法海大师发现踪迹。许仙盗草救妻时遭妖灵附体，法海留他在金山寺保命。复原后的白蛇心急救夫，与法海展开大比拼，却导致生灵涂炭！

programme.title: 香港兰桂坊
programme.desc: 这部香港特色电影，汇集了中港台影星胡渭康、祁迹、张建声等，讲述大型广告拍摄在即，广告公司的制作部主管李丽却因重遇前度终日在兰桂坊借酒消愁。最后，她在陈明声的鼓励下重新振作起来。

programme.title: Z风暴
programme.desc: 廉政公署首席调查主任揭露牵涉香港政府的150亿「关怀基金」的庞大诈骗计划。廉政公署誓要跟幕后黑手斗智斗力，还香港一个廉洁都市的称号。

programme.title: 好好拍电影
programme.desc: 文念中花三年时间首次执导的纪录片，记录香港名导演许鞍华的电影人生。此片利用了电影片段，真诚的对话，许鞍华之合作伙伴、朋友和家人的访问，拍出许导演四十载光影人生的高低起伏。

programme.title: 困兽
programme.desc: 警方联合博彩协会整顿地下博彩业，并将新建赌场经营权以拍卖形式处理。不为人知的利益和秘密跟着被揭露，更引起各方人马的冲突...

programme.title: 山忌黄衣小飞侠
programme.desc: 摄影师与友人前往偏远山林取景，却不小心闯入了被当地人称为「山忌」的禁地，连串诡异事件随之而来。浓雾的山林中，一名能够在山间飞跃的黄色雨衣少年现身，揭开尘封已久的诅咒与恐怖秘密。

programme.title: 流浪地球2
programme.desc: 太阳即将毁灭，人类打算启动"流浪地球"计划，建造巨大推进器，寻找新的家园。学者们采取了不少技术应对环境变化，面对末日灾难与生命存续的双重挑战，流浪地球时代的年轻人挺身而出，展开争分夺秒的生死之战。

programme.title: 李茂扮太子
programme.desc: 恩爱的小捕快李茂与富家女成婚后，依然得不到其父母认同。一天，李茂意外发现自己与太子的样貌相同，一个想入宫获得晋升，一个则欲获自由，于是两人決定交换身份，怎知却被卷入尚书的阴谋里。

programme.title: 出埃及記
programme.desc: 一位军装警员发现有个女人组织，正进行歼灭全世界男人的计划，而他的上司方子晴督察和妻子竟也是组织成员...

programme.title: 速战
programme.desc: 阿楠和阿火是赛车界的顶尖车神。阿楠因导致年青车手受伤，变得意志消沉。为鼓励阿楠，阿火遂参加非法街头赛车，最后他能否成功?

programme.title: 72家租客
programme.desc: 一对结拜兄弟因爱上的女孩下嫁他們其中一人，從此成为世仇。直至四十年后，二人的种种恩怨，最终因为大业主强收物业的问题而渐渐得到化解。

programme.title: 正义回廊
programme.desc: 改编轰动全港的"逆子弒亲案"，写下香港限制级电影票房新纪录。一名青年联同友人杀害并肢解父母，两人皆否认谋杀，代表二人的资深大律师在庭上突袭互攻，而九位陪审员也在裁判室展开话语权角力，思辩案情真相。

programme.title: 功夫
programme.desc: 周星驰身兼导编演的经典作品之一。贯彻星爷无厘头、夸张的搞笑风格，故事取景于1940年代的中国，讲述一名无所作为的小混混阿星，为加入当地最大帮派的故事。此片大获好评之外，也一度掀起斧头帮舞热潮。

programme.desc: 美食旅游节目「食尚玩家」带你走遍台湾与世界各地，寻找在地美食，体验最道地的旅游行程。

programme.title: 国民大会
programme.desc: 「国民大会」从台湾的人、台湾的事，畅谈台湾的故事，以深入浅出，轻松幽默的不同面向解读社会时事的氛围。

programme.title: FOCUS全球新闻
programme.desc: 聚焦全球大事，从华府到北京，从欧美到亚非，从政治、经济到科技与文化，透过深度而完整的报导，带领观众进入关键事件的核心，补给面向世界的知识能量，掌握国际发展趋势。

programme.title: 最前线新闻
programme.desc: 深入报导全球重大议题与人物访谈。

programme.title: 女人我最大
programme.desc: 最近流行什么服饰?最潮时尚品有哪些?出席不同场合该如何打扮?化妆品怎样用才对?让名主持人蓝心湄与女人兵团，在时尚美容达人带领下，教你从头到脚的保养护理方法和秘诀，一起变成"靓靓Baby"!

programme.title: 食尚玩家:我们这一家
programme.desc: 《我们这一家》以三世代同游同食为主轴，走访在地美食，透过不同价值观的碰撞与理解，用吃喝玩乐串起世代故事

programme.title: 11点热吵店
programme.desc: 《11点热吵店》透过年轻世代的角度，无论是两性、职场、人际、时事娱乐等，大谈他们最关心、最想发泄、最有意见的热门话题！

programme.title: 七仙女
programme.desc: 玉帝之小女儿七仙女，厌倦了天庭刻板生活，不惜冒犯天规并降入人间。七仙女因被少年董永的孝心所感动，幻身村姑与其结成夫妻，一起为生活打拼。然而愉快的凡间生活，能持续多久?

programme.title: 毒龙潭
programme.desc: 二十年前，歹徒唐大川为称霸武林，不惜利用樊瑛的感情，来盗取被镇压多年的玉龙剑，导致两人的一对儿女被迫分离。二十年后，玉龙剑再次被盗，唯这一次所掀起的，是一场难以收拾的武林残局。

programme.title: 夕阳恋人
programme.desc: 陈仲达偶遇黄小萍，因误会不欢而散。后见陈在雨中苦候自己，好感渐生。陈自称为孤儿，实为太子爷。当黄悉破陈的身份后，深感受骗；黄辗转遇上车祸，命在旦夕！此片为秦沛年少知名之作，少男情怀演绎得恰如其分！

programme.title: 飞刀手
programme.desc: 动作大导演张彻在一派阳刚剑客潮流中，以灵巧的飞刀开创新颖题材，并邀来武侠天后郑佩佩和罗烈，上演荡气回肠的江湖儿女情。于英为复仇求助生性风流的飞刀手杨青，但相处日久后才明白他其实深爱自己。

programme.title: 女校春色
programme.desc: 在女校任教的陈子风，改变了校园保守的风气，大受学生欢迎，好友李海伦更对他渐生情愫。不料校内保守派不满子风的所作所为，伺机将他铲除！

programme.title: 女校春色
programme.desc: 在女校任教的陈子风，改变了校园保守的风气，大受学生欢迎，好友李海伦更对他渐生情愫。不料校内保守派不满子风的所作所为，伺机将他铲除！

programme.title: 怪侠
programme.desc: 怪侠江丹枫家人都被土匪杀害，遂发誓必杀尽此等败类。一次江杀土匪沙如虎，沙临终时哀求江将遗物交予其妹秀秀，江允之；秀得知兄死讯愤然砍伤江！秀感到后悔，决定留江在家养伤，却招来另一群大盗向江复仇！

programme.title: 北地胭脂
programme.desc: 一代大师李翰祥编导的典型艳情喜剧，分别演绎不甘沦落为娼的妓女冒险向巡官告状；到妓院寻欢的同治皇帝染上梅毒；正德皇帝与名妓的艳史，三个发生在妓院百花楼的奇情艳遇。

programme.title: 军阀趣史
programme.desc: 讲述一位山东军阀的轶闻趣事，主要集中在风流韵事上，查暗娼、访私娼，叔嫂通奸、姨太偷情。胡锦、邵音音、余莎莉、楚湘云等一班艳星各展风情，噱头十足。

programme.title: 满天神佛
programme.desc: 青年术士鲁兴与好友因功力太差被女鬼戏弄险丧命，幸获连大师施法相助，于是，两个人立马拜他为师。当其好友意外地被日本忍者杀死时，鲁兴决定要学习绝世茅术，与大师一同对付残暴的忍者。

programme.title: 老夫子奇趣录
programme.desc: 由笑匠王沙扮演老夫子，矮冬瓜扮大番薯，一肥一瘦配搭，大放笑弹。故事以古董奸商欲偷取老夫子的鸳鸯古董花瓶为始，最终反而被老夫子设计骗回二万元，并将花瓶卖得的二十万元捐作善款。故事既轻松又具教育意义。

programme.title: 水浒传
programme.desc: 大导演张彻的经典作品之一，姜大卫、狄龙、岳华、谷峰、陈观泰、丹波哲郎、何莉莉等众星云集，演绎梁山兄弟企图说服卢俊义入伙梁山替晁盖复仇，不料卢俊义遭陷害被捕，一场梁山好汉与官府的大战一触即发！

programme.title: 玉堂春
programme.desc: 穷书生王金龙与名妓苏三相爱，老鸨却将她卖给富户当妾，不料却被诬告毒杀亲夫，判以死罪！已考取功名的金龙，决定开堂复审，拯救苏三！

programme.title: 恶爷
programme.desc: 恶少爷红毛九老爱在苏记饭店滋事捣蛋，苏老板欺善怕恶，唯有把怨气发在伙计阿七身上。阿七无意发现厨师张彪武功非凡，便暗中模仿其动作练武。某日，红毛九又仗势欺人，这一次阿七还会忍气吞声吗?

programme.title: 倩女幽魂
programme.desc: 曾获戛纳电影节金棕榈奖提名。宁采臣落脚金华古寺，夜逢女鬼聂小倩。小倩以美色诱人，只为奉献给她的主人姥姥。小倩本欲加害采臣，但为其忠厚耿直感动，两人渐生感情。姥姥得知此事，誓要铲除二人！

programme.title: 女杀手
programme.desc: 身手敏捷的"女杀手"在一次杀人事件中，遭人悉破其真实身份，而被迫成为该组织的杀人工具。岂料在完成一次任务之后，她险些掉入组织设下的灭口陷阱！为摆脱他们的魔掌，她决心反攻，誓要将整个组织连根拔起！

programme.title: 后门
programme.desc: 李翰祥导演，当年荣获多个电影奖项的经典作品。赚人热泪的剧情，因膝下无儿的徐天鹤夫妇，收养邻家女儿阿琳而展开。胡蝶当年也凭此片，夺得她从影30年来，首座最佳女主角奖。大导胡金铨、影后乐蒂也有份客串演出！

programme.title: 洪熙官
programme.desc: 刘家良身兼导演与武指，以传奇人物洪熙官为题材，讲述洪氏两代人对抗清廷叛徒白眉道人的故事。多次在不同的电影中饰演洪熙官，陈观泰可谓洪的最佳代表之一。

programme.title: 乾隆下扬州
programme.desc: 大导演李翰祥的清装喜剧，以乾隆下江南一段野史，揉合民间传奇，借古讽今，幽默隽永，创造出银幕上乾隆皇帝儒雅风流的贤君形象。

programme.title: 死囚
programme.desc: 亚洲影帝姜大卫自导自演，倪匡编剧，讲述流浪汉冯大刚含冤入狱，在狱中遇上扒手杨灵。正义的杨灵得知大刚蒙冤，决定联手越狱，不料这次越狱，竟导致两人成为真正的死囚！

programme.title: 死囚
programme.desc: 亚洲影帝姜大卫自导自演，倪匡编剧，讲述流浪汉冯大刚含冤入狱，在狱中遇上扒手杨灵。正义的杨灵得知大刚蒙冤，决定联手越狱，不料这次越狱，竟导致两人成为真正的死囚！

programme.title: 鳄鱼河
programme.desc: 张冲及李婷为大学同学，两人堕入爱河，可惜两家上一代结怨二十年，两家对岸隔河而居，其间不设桥梁，河中尤多鳄鱼，游者有被噬之险，形成对峙之势！罗维自导自演之作，堪称六十年代版的《罗密欧与茱丽叶》。

programme.title: 水晶人
programme.desc: 改编自黄鹰的同名小说，故事讲述龙飞精心雕琢的水晶美人像忽然失踪后，多位黑道高手离奇被杀，江湖传言是水晶人变成精灵杀人。龙飞经过连番追查之后，发现水晶人是受训杀手，而背后更有不可告人的阴谋！

programme.title: 夜生活的女人
programme.desc: 香港邵氏的经典电影，由《夜生活的女人》、《女秘书与色狼》和《偷窥狂》三个故事组成，讲述喧嚣繁杂的都市夜生活背后，所发生的光怪陆离的故事。

programme.title: 追魂镖
programme.desc: 大侠刘文龙在妻子遇害惨死后，携儿子、忠仆和徒弟胡子峰天涯寻仇。子峰不耐枯寂生活，竟非礼村妇，遭撞破后夺去刘的追魂镖杀妇逃走！刘收养妇人的遗孤玉蝉为徒，一次玉蝉偶遇胡，却误信其言以为刘是杀母仇人！

programme.title: 警察
programme.desc: 梁观和女友沉燕在郊外游玩谈心时，遇上歹徒劫财劫色，梁护花不成更惨遭毒手。黄国栋为替挚友报仇，毅然投身警界，希望能亲自缉查凶手。五年后，一宗离奇谋杀桉件，让梁的死亡真相出现转机！

programme.title: 我们恋爱去了
programme.desc: 古语有云，先成家后立业，管氏企业准继承人管大用，却为成家一事苦恼不已，并对母亲所安排的对象毫无兴趣。他想尽办法摆脱婚事，期间却意外遇上令他心动的连莲。曾结下恩怨的两人，是否是彼此的幸福终站?

programme.title: 大旗英雄传
programme.desc: 大旗门掌舵人的义子铁中棠，遭仇人司徒笑追杀，欲夺取大旗门秘密宝藏。铁中棠前往长春岛，探索大旗门的一切，碰见夜帝铁毅，更发现自己的身世真相！

programme.title: 扭计祖宗陈梦吉
programme.desc: 华南影帝张瑛和梁天合作的清末喜剧，两人分别饰演刁师爷荒唐镜以及足智多谋的陈梦吉，角色斗智斗力也斗演技！陈梦吉得知荒唐镜刻薄成性，于是扮成仆人应聘，展开一场脑筋大比拼！

programme.title: 卒仔抽车
programme.desc: 当乐天派穷小子阿旦，遇上生活寂寥的富家子弟崔东成，竟引来一场足于改变阿旦命运的赌局！阿旦决定与三名好友联手接受崔东成的挑战。四个臭皮匠能否胜过一个诸葛亮?

programme.title: 阿牛出狱记
programme.desc: 出狱后的阿牛，从澳门回到香港打拼生活，找到工作后却被周大叔欺骗，更被人打得遍体鳞伤，奄奄一息。阿牛一生命苦，却生性乐观积极，戏里的笑料都反映了当年社会困境，笑中有泪，发人省思。

programme.title: 大刀王五
programme.desc: 大刀王五为北京城内豪杰。谭嗣同入京参议新政，仰慕王五侠义之名，有心结识。二人相见甚欢，结为异姓兄弟。未几西太后废止变法，打压新党。谭嗣同选择以身殉新法。王五与谭妹苦劝无果，遂决定于行刑时劫法场救人。

programme.title: 我爱金龟婿
programme.desc: 三个香港美少女远赴日本大阪，一心要钓个金龟婿，但她们的黄金梦逐一幻灭。三人被迫入住一间别墅小房，却被误会是富家千金，闹出连串笑话，更发展出意想不到的浪漫奇遇。

programme.title: 金臂童
programme.desc: 虎威镖局受命押送官府二十万两黄金，赴黄河流域赈灾济民。途中各路武林豪杰纷纷前来助阵，硬撼七杀谷一批武功高强的盗匪。正邪两派人马各施奇谋，恶斗连场，赈灾黄金能顺利送抵目的地吗?

programme.title: 西厢记
programme.desc: 深受欢迎的中国传统戏曲《西厢记》改编，岳枫执导，凌波反串张生、李菁饰演红娘、方盈饰演崔莺莺，讲述才子张生与富家女莺莺之间，撼动人心的爱情故事。

programme.title: 西厢记
programme.desc: 深受欢迎的中国传统戏曲《西厢记》改编，岳枫执导，凌波反串张生、李菁饰演红娘、方盈饰演崔莺莺，讲述才子张生与富家女莺莺之间，撼动人心的爱情故事。

programme.title: 孔雀王朝
programme.desc: 改编自古龙小说《武林外史》，剧情主要描述魔头欢喜王意欲称霸武林，各大派高手于是联合起来进行对抗。以缉捕匪徒领取赏金为生的游侠沉浪也被邀加入其中，本以为十拿九稳，没想到却误入欢喜王的圈套！

programme.title: 港澳传奇
programme.desc: 李翰祥执导的"风流十锦喜剧"之一，谷峰、王侠、陈萍、恬妮等人主演，全片由两个逗趣单元组成，讲述六对都市男女之间，跨越禁忌界线的爱情故事。

programme.title: 南斗官三斗北少爷
programme.desc: 经常闯祸的广东大良富家子南斗官，表面上奉母命上京参加招亲大会，实际上却是为了寻找名传京城的千术北少爷、泡妞北少爷和神偷北少爷过招。四人不打不相识，结成好友，更合力对付居心不良的三眼道人！

programme.title: 玉女亲情
programme.desc: 少女张爱珠无意间得知自己非其父母的亲生女，故决定离家寻找生母。徘徊在拥有血缘关系的生母和对自己疼爱有加的养父母之间，哪一边才是爱珠真正想要的家?

programme.title: 蓝与黑
programme.desc: 影后林黛演技大发挥，由楚楚可怜的少女，到清纯秀丽的护士，乃至浓艳慑人的歌女，与关山上演一段触动人心的抗战爱情故事。

programme.title: 江湖三女侠
programme.desc: 故事讲述被江湖各派推举为"武林之尊"的修德武馆，被胸怀野心的朱天翔踢馆捣乱，幸得少主人徐近武打退。天翔得知韩氏三姐妹若兰、如玫、晓莲家藏威力惊人的玄铁神剑，若能夺得，武馆必败，遂以花言巧语骗得神剑！

programme.title: 武松
programme.desc: 香港名导李翰祥经典电影之一，改编自家喻户晓的《水浒传》，刻划武松打虎的英勇事迹，以及与武大郎的兄弟情谊，最终手刃谋害亲夫的潘金莲和西门庆。由狄龙、汪萍、谷峰、刘永等主演，1982年金马奖包揽三项大奖。

programme.title: 千门八将
programme.desc: 千门正将陈云，被胡冠天暗算，气得吐血而亡！其子陈继千为报父仇，邀"千门八将"：提、反、脱、风、火、徐、谣相助；一场又一场赌桌上的斗智令人叹为观止!王晶早期编剧作品，被视为《赌神》雏形的八十年代佳作。

programme.title: 拜倒石榴裙
programme.desc: 丁芝华凭着漂亮外形到处行骗，一钻石戒指得手后，芝华打算搭飞机回新加坡，不料钻石被禁进口！于是芝华情急智生，将戒指盒放进富家子张志贤衣袋。芝华辗转找到志贤，再次使用诡计取回钻石戒指！

programme.title: 黑蜥蜴
programme.desc: 著名武侠小说家黄鹰之同名小说改编，扑朔迷离的故事情节，围绕在一对感情要好的同门师兄弟身上。纠缠不清的恩怨情仇，因一个美丽的误会而产生，却不慎引发一场又一场的家庭悲剧。当真相被揭发时，他们该如何是好?

programme.title: 狂恋诗
programme.desc: 大伟和小春两个性格迥异的兄弟，同时爱上珠迪。大伟发现珠迪有个年老丈夫，强迫珠迪跟他幽会，珠迪从此周旋于三个男人之间。本片大胆描写男女情欲关系，题材罕见，加上演员奔放，颇有欧陆风格，结局更是出人意表！

programme.title: 清宫启示录
programme.desc: 康熙决定传位于十四太子,十四太子忽遭蒙面杀手行刺，幸为亲信曾静所救。原来四太子觊觎帝位，派人行刺胞弟。四太子计划失败后，四出求贤，觅得文武双全之年羹尧相助，更拉拢反吕留良及吕四娘等，誓要争取皇位。

programme.title: 佛跳牆
programme.desc: 李翰祥执导，取材于民间济公信仰，透过济公协助一对母子逃过丧命之危、助菜贩逃离高利贷滋扰及教训权贵恶霸等行善惩恶的小故事，带出善恶终有报的真理。

programme.title: 叉手
programme.desc: 神秘蒙面杀手出没，专杀江湖豪侠，导致人心惶惶。以八臂哪吒为首的一批志士，赴景阳镇调查杀手总坛所在，展开惊心动魄的一场江湖追逐战！

programme.title: 叉手
programme.desc: 神秘蒙面杀手出没，专杀江湖豪侠，导致人心惶惶。以八臂哪吒为首的一批志士，赴景阳镇调查杀手总坛所在，展开惊心动魄的一场江湖追逐战！

programme.title: 三笑
programme.desc: 凌波反串风流倜傥的唐伯虎，搭配大美人李菁，演绎家喻户晓的唐伯虎点秋香黄梅调版本。唐伯虎到苏州虎丘山游玩，遇上美艳出众的秋香，临行前向伯虎一笑、再笑、三笑，让他神魂颠倒，展开热烈追求。

programme.title: 方世玉与胡惠乾
programme.desc: 武当派败类白眉道人、冯道德、雷老虎等勾结清廷，残杀武林中人，方世玉与胡惠乾皆背负血海深仇。同病相怜的两人携手前往少林寺，练就高强武功后下山复仇，少林与武当之战再掀腥风血雨！

programme.title: 海军突击队
programme.desc: 狄龙、傅声、姜大卫、刘永等巨星携手合作，上演一段中国海军捍卫国土的英勇故事。以第二次世界大战日军侵占上海为背景，军力稍占下风的中国海军，能否凭其设下的水雷和突击行动，击退日军?

programme.title: 天龙八部
programme.desc: 大理国王子段誉私闯江湖期间，巧遇女侠木婉清，及后两人互生情愫，不料婉清突然遭人袭击，段誉也不幸成为黄袍人的杀害对象。追根究底，一切乃上一代所种下的恶果。无辜的段誉能逃过一劫吗?

programme.title: 神剑震江湖
programme.desc: 余干文奉命寻找天地剑以免除武林浩劫，遇上五毒教主之女苏皎皎，两人情投意合，但正邪不两立，这对苦命鸳鸯为躲避武林人士的追逼，只得四处逃亡！

programme.title: 倾国倾城
programme.desc: 李翰祥执导，联同狄龙、卢燕、凌波、姜大卫等巨星，打造史诗宫廷电影巨作，一举拿下金马奖最佳剧情片、最佳女主角、最佳美术设计大奖。光绪二十年，光绪帝在位，西太后却依然大权在握，清宫权力斗争风起云涌。

programme.title: 吉祥赌坊
programme.desc: 人生就像一场赌注，你愿意为了捍卫正义而将你的人生当作赌注吗?失散多年后重遇的一对情人，誓言携手对付贪污腐败的军阀及不法份子，却在捍卫正义时惹来血光之灾！

programme.title: 老夫子
programme.desc: 老夫子祸不单行|公园晨运遭洗劫|巴士上帮妇孺|却导致自己上班迟到遭开除。否极泰来|老夫子一次英雄救美|打动陈小姐芳心。迎娶新娘当天|上天再次考验老夫子|这次他会逃过这一劫吗?

programme.title: 八道楼子
programme.desc: 长城战役之古北口八达岭战场改编，动作电影天王张彻破格之作，成功把功夫动作与战争场面融为一体的同时，对世界各国陆军战争电影带来极大影响。炮火与肌肉的完美结合，细述"八道楼子"抗日英雄的传奇事迹。

programme.title: 遗产五亿圆
programme.desc: 司徒佩芳、彭静娴及李蓉蓉分别接到来自日本华侨富翁的来信，自认是她们的父亲，将家产五亿元分赠给她们，要她们从香港去日本和他见面。蒋彬是富翁法律顾问的远亲，赴日料理後事。岂料在这途中，各人却陷入危机中!

programme.title: 小子有种
programme.desc: 镇上有个放洋流学回来的假洋鬼子处处欺压村民。张小泰利用中国功夫，与假洋鬼子唐罗拔争女友。傅声和黄杏秀以功夫跳西洋舞，惹笑风趣。傅声充满反叛气息，和谷峰拍档演斗气父子，一老一少，对白幽默，充满时代感。

programme.title: 七十二家房客
programme.desc: 当年击败李小龙的《猛龙过江》，勇夺香港票房冠军的小人物狂想曲电影！由楚原执导，沉殿霞、岳华、何守信、胡锦、井莉等倾巢演出，一栋旧式庭院住着七十二家房客，细看他们如何合力逼退专横的太子炳和包租婆！

programme.title: 玉面侠
programme.desc: 古龙名作《绝代双骄》改编，大侠章臻与婢女月奴的双胞胎儿女，惨遭章臻师姐设下毒计，让兄妹二人自小分隔两地与正邪两派。十八年后，当兄妹俩再次聚首，掀起一场相隔两代、恩情爱情难解难分的江湖风雨！

programme.title: 乔太守乱点鸳鸯谱
programme.desc: 由罗臻、薛群联合执导的著名黄梅调喜剧电影，讲述孙玉郎和刘慧娘情投意合，却因为错送定情信物，与裴政和徐文姑错点鸳鸯。几对痴情男女，最终能不能有情人终成眷属?

programme.title: 乔太守乱点鸳鸯谱
programme.desc: 由罗臻、薛群联合执导的著名黄梅调喜剧电影，讲述孙玉郎和刘慧娘情投意合，却因为错送定情信物，与裴政和徐文姑错点鸳鸯。几对痴情男女，最终能不能有情人终成眷属?

programme.title: 太阴指
programme.desc: 金汉与凌波夫妇在1971年联手演出的作品。精彩动作场面不断，高潮迭起的剧情，因隐退江湖的路天保和结拜兄弟，巧遇替"活死人"门派清理门户的女弟子而展开。

programme.title: 梁山伯与祝英台
programme.desc: 大导演李翰祥最经典的黄梅调电影，荣获金马奖最佳剧情片、导演、女主角等六大奖项。由凌波和乐蒂分别饰演梁山伯与祝英台，演绎这段千古断肠的凄美民间故事。

programme.title: 八国联军
programme.desc: 清朝末年，正值局势腐败，民不聊生；慈禧太后不思整顿朝庭，还迷信自称无坚不摧的"义和团"可凌驾洋人，决意向列强宣战，反让八国联军有机可乘，引发一场一发不可收拾的战争。

programme.title: 锦衣卫
programme.desc: 明英宗皇帝昏庸无能，使其大权落入宦官王振之手；他操纵锦衣卫，利用他们诛杀异己。锦衣卫统领赵不凡，因多次在几次暗杀行动中义释忠良，而让王振记恨在心，故威逼身为锦衣卫总管的赵父追杀赵不凡。

programme.title: 香江花月夜

programme.title: 痳疯怪拳

programme.title: 燕娘

programme.title: 踩綫
programme.desc: 吕良伟与李修贤在片中均为中越混血儿，由越南逃至澳门；吕于香港出生，乃与李分散；郑则仕饰吕之叔父，为一干练警探，即介绍吕加入警界，派其作卧底。后郑一次与越南匪徒激斗中遭杀害；而李则被牵涉入这宗凶案。

programme.title: 宝莲灯
programme.desc: 中国民间神话改编，林黛、李菁与郑佩佩，三位影后级人马同场尬戏，上演沉香劈山救母的传奇故事。以绝代美貌著称影界的林黛，在影片中难得反串男角饰演沉香，也分饰圣母三娘一角；唯当年电影上映之前，她已撒手人寰

programme.title: 万箭穿心
programme.desc: 马庆庭、向独步、金梁义结金兰，专与元军作对，并誓生死与共，否则万箭穿心。马庆庭借救沙贝姑郡主来假意归附元朝，进而获封凤阳镇威大将军。三人兄弟之情，逐渐走向决裂。权势当前，人性的邪恶无所遁形。

programme.title: 杨贵妃
programme.desc: 李丽华 I 严俊 I 李香君

programme.title: 流氓千王
programme.desc: 集合赌博、千术、骗局、搞笑和动作元素的80年代电影，李修贤和宗华饰演赌术精湛的流氓千王，但一山还有一山高，李修贤在澳门赌场败给千后陈萍，因此联同宗华密谋复仇雪耻，开设豪华赌局引陈萍入局！

programme.title: 流氓千王
programme.desc: 集合赌博、千术、骗局、搞笑和动作元素的80年代电影，李修贤和宗华饰演赌术精湛的流氓千王，但一山还有一山高，李修贤在澳门赌场败给千后陈萍，因此联同宗华密谋复仇雪耻，开设豪华赌局引陈萍入局！

programme.title: 死角
programme.desc: 金马影帝狄龙首次担正，联同亚洲影帝姜大卫及娃娃影后李菁合演的经典之作。张纯恋上富家女温柔，却遭到对方兄长极力反对。张纯偶然间拾获一把手枪，命运从此改变！

programme.title: 万人斩
programme.desc: 以人皆所欲、斩破贪念和舍身成仁作为故事的题材，陈观泰饰演总捕头冷天鹰，表现出彩。冷天鹰除了在缉捕匪徒时有精彩的战斗场面，也有激情的情感戏。导演桂治洪唯一古装武侠作品，格局精奇，拍出肃杀和深沉的气氛。

programme.title: 降头
programme.desc: 科幻作家倪匡担任编剧，诡异连连的故事情节，因狄龙遇上单恋于他的恬妮而展开。心术不正的恬妮为夺取狄龙欢心，不惜使用邪术降头，却牵引出一场因爱而生的邪术之战。充满悬念又刺激的剧情，结局更是出乎你我预料。

programme.title: 洪熙官
programme.desc: 刘家良身兼导演与武指，以传奇人物洪熙官为题材，讲述洪氏两代人对抗清廷叛徒白眉道人的故事。多次在不同的电影中饰演洪熙官，陈观泰可谓洪的最佳代表之一。

programme.title: 怪侠
programme.desc: 怪侠江丹枫家人都被土匪杀害，遂发誓必杀尽此等败类。一次江杀土匪沙如虎，沙临终时哀求江将遗物交予其妹秀秀，江允之；秀得知兄死讯愤然砍伤江！秀感到后悔，决定留江在家养伤，却招来另一群大盗向江复仇！

programme.title: 乾隆皇君臣斗智
programme.desc: 历史宫闱片大师李翰祥又一杰作，刘永饰演乾的隆皇一角更是深入民心。当诡计多端的乾隆皇，遇上足智多谋的翰林院大学士左都御史刘墉，展开一场又一场妙趣横生的君臣斗。

programme.title: 隐身女侠
programme.desc: 故事讲述一位年轻女剑客喝下奶奶研制的隐身药后，变成白天隐形晚上现身的怪人。她无意中捣乱了黑道首领女儿的婚事，惹来连番追杀，最后如何脱险?

programme.title: 牛鬼蛇神
programme.desc: 大导演李翰祥以嬉笑怒骂的喜剧片，描述军阀割据时代，江湖人物和狡黠之徒妖言惑众，欺骗愚民上钓，借以反映旧时代牛鬼蛇神众生相，发人省思。

programme.title: 飞龙斩
programme.desc: 为求荣华富贵，八旗统领司马骏竟不惜一切，协助身患重病的奸相寻找解药。他滥杀无辜，更不惜与师弟铁二郎结怨。二郎和药师之女合力展开复仇计划，唯司马骏的杀手锏飞龙斩却让他们难以招架，复仇能否成功?

programme.title: 夺棍
programme.desc: 当阿檬遇上朱头炳，一趟本是惊险无比的拯救绝代棍王之旅，竟闹出连串笑话。且看香港喜剧幕后推手王晶，早期在担任编剧时，如何发挥无厘头本色，与导演袁浩泉一起打造这部经典功夫喜剧。

programme.title: 星际钝胎
programme.desc: 结合外星人、飞碟以及爱情的港产科幻喜剧，讲述性感又无知的漂亮宝贝，遭外星人掳走发生第三类接触，却无人相信她，准备轻生以示清白时，遇上同病相怜的私家侦探，两人展开了一段鲜花配牛粪的爱情奇遇！

programme.title: 大侠沉胜衣
programme.desc: 改编自黄鹰武侠名著，由金马影帝狄龙、井莉、欧阳佩珊等人主演，讲述大侠沈胜衣和步烟飞，为了保护挚友之女白冰，与"金梅盗"慕容孤芳斗智斗勇，不料金梅盗的真正目标，是要夺取白家的《唐门火册》！

programme.title: 花木兰
programme.desc: 一代巾帼花木兰的故事改编|把花木兰乔装男儿身代父从军|征战十二年并擒拿突厥王的传奇|活现于电影荧幕。著名女星凌波当年也凭此片|夺得第十一届亚洲影展最佳女主角殊荣。

programme.title: 明月刀雪夜歼仇
programme.desc: 改编自古龙《边城浪子》，1977年十大卖座武侠片，讲述天下第一快刀傅红雪万里寻凶报父仇，途中七名凶手竟一一离奇暴毙。他与好友叶开多番追查，惊觉七名凶手全都未死。究竟这七个人又设下了什么大阴谋?

programme.title: 红楼梦
programme.desc: 导演袁秋枫这部黄梅调《红楼梦》被誉为电影经典，音乐大师王福龄的音乐，把宝黛之恋的悲情推上高峰！黛玉葬花，晴雯之死等画面，拍出人世悲凉，让人感伤。强大的花旦阵容如乐蒂、丁红、高树宝等堪称一时之选！

programme.title: 凤凰焦点新闻

programme.title: 新闻今日谈

programme.title: 纪录片-三天 Tập 722
programme.desc: 本节目通过3天72个小时不间断的拍摄来观察在极容易被我们忽视的场所，或者我们经常光顾的场所生活、工作、来往的普通人的日常生活和各种情况的变化，最大程度的突出了纪录片的现场感和真实感。不同于其他节目的一点是，不特别安排出演人员，以在拍摄现场遇到的人为中心进行采访，因此主要选择人流量大的地方为主要采访地，比如说：长途汽车客运站、江南站十字路口、鲜血车、医院的急救室、霹雳舞男孩大会等活动场地等。

Three couples face a series of questions which hurtle down The Answer Run towards them. Beside each question is a pair of 50/50 answers. As the questions come thick and fast, contestants swipe left or right for the correct answer.

programme.title: World’s Wildest Weather: Caught On Camera - EP 3 - EP 3
programme.desc: A funny and frightening rollercoaster journey investigating our planet’s most extreme weather as told and filmed by ordinary people caught in the eye of the storm’. We follow the incredible human stories of the families caught up in snowstorms, avalanches, floods, landslides, terrifying wildfires and too close for comfort lightning strikes. The film uses jaw dropping, often never-before-seen footage, captured on cameras and phones.

programme.title: Freshly Picked with Simon Toohey S3 - EP 3 - EP 3
programme.desc: Discover the ultimate in feel-good food with Simon Toohey in Freshly Picked, returning for season three to explore the benefits of sustainable, fresh, flavour-packed cooking. Along the way, Simon shows us how to build exciting flavour combinations with everyday fruit and veggies and dishes out plenty of tips on how to eat fresh and get it right.

programme.title: Nico’s Cook in, Cook Out - EP 5 - EP 5

To begin, a light and tasty starter of Chicken & Bacon Skewers with a Lime and Coriander Slaw, an impressive flame cooked main course of Grilled Rack of Lamb with a Butterbean Salad and the perfect way to end a meal, Mango & White Chocolate Cheesecake for two!

programme.title: Big Adventures: Into the Gobi Desert with Nick Knowles - EP 3 - EP 3
programme.desc: Nick Knowles returns for a truly spectacular adventure, this time in the most desolate place on earth, the Gobi Desert. At five times the size of the UK, with the smallest population on earth, Mongolia is vast and remote and the stunning wilderness of the Gobi covers a third of the country.

programme.title: Nightmare
programme.desc: A mental-patient, who is troubled with horrible nightmares, has escaped from his hospital. Now on the streets he can’t help killing innocent people. But there is one family he is more than interested in and when he tries to kill them, he finds that it’s not that easy.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: An Italian prison warden is forced to exchange a French criminal for his kidnapped wife, but they soon discover a larger conspiracy.

programme.title: The Hellbenders
programme.desc: After the civil war, a hell-bent Confederate Army Officer and his sons rob a Union Caravan carrying a fortune, killing every man and beast in the process. They hide the money in an empty coffin and hire a woman to pose as a widow to a dead officer to make it look official. Now they must con and fight their way across the west through thousands of cavalry, lawmen, bounty hunters, and Indians to make their escape.

programme.title: Nota Silam

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: Five Tough Guys
programme.desc: A titular gang of misfits come together to protect a patriotic general from a scheming usurper. To this end, the unlikely heroes act as the general's escorts on a dangerous journey to a distant British consulate, beset by enemies and sinister Japanese interference along the way.

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancee Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wang's friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlord's home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two help the revolutionists' cause with the stolen money?

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesn't care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dupe to get it.

programme.title: The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: Warrior Tuan Chang Qing meets courtesan Liu Yin Xi in a small town. Liu pleads Tuan to kill the underworld master Guo Tian Sheng, known as the "Killer Doctor", in order to avenge the death of her fiance. Tuan and gambling addict Xiao Dao breaks into Guo's household, triggering the battle of good against evil.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiance Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan...

programme.title: The Singing Thief
programme.desc: A master jewel thief turns over a new leaf as a professional singer in a nightclub. However, a series of robberies happened shortly after and he becomes the suspect again. The thief then sets up a trap to snare the copycat but will this backfire on him?

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: Six Assassins
programme.desc: Lord Li Ming is a feudal tyrant who oppresses the people, and even the Emperor who is his brother, cannot stop his evil act. Righteous swordsman Mu poses as Li Ming's guard to plan for his assassination. He arrests six assassins who have tried to kill Li Ming, before making them his allies in a secret plot to kill him and end the tyranny.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: Fan is cheated by her lover Tong to steal her master's Jade Dragon Sword. She is jailed in the Dragon Swamp as punishment and gave birth to a pair of twins - her daughter is raised by her master, while her son is taken by Tong. Twenty years later, the sword is stolen again and Fan's daughter goes seeking for it, meeting Fan's friend along the way.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: The Yu family and the Green Dragon clan became enemies when the Yu daughter killed the clan head's son, who was a rapist and murderer. The Green Dragon leader wounds the head of the Yu family with his flying daggers, and a wandering swordsman saves the family using his own flying dagger skills. However, his allegiances and motives are unclear.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: The Magnificent Swordsman centres on the hero who vows vengeance against evil bandits who killed his family when he was a child. The hero recruits several friends to help the peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader of the band being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are nearly killed by a female ghost during an exorcism. Luckily, Master Lian saves their lives, so they beseech him to teach them his skills. When his friend is killed by ruthless ninjas, Lu decides to learn the ultimate witchcraft and teams up with his master to defeat them.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, which will prove hard to overcome...

programme.title: The Bully
programme.desc: For lovers of the Shaw's sumptuous production and martial arts expertise, this action adventure in the "Jackie Chan style" is a special treat. A persecuted waiter turns to a "drunken master" for help when a restaurant customer turns out to be a kung-fu harbinger of doom!

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demon's clutches.

programme.title: The Lady Professional
programme.desc: Lily Ho is perfectly cast as a gun-for-hire who always gets her man - in more ways than one! The cast and crew shot on location in Japanese scenic spots such as Mount Fuji; and there are plenty of over-the-top thrills, as Lily even masquerades as a nun.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolin's Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hung's son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents' kung fu styles.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: Feng, a homeless man, is wrongly accused of robbery and subsequently arrested and imprisoned. The actual bandit bribes fellow inmate Yang, a pickpocket, to kill Feng. Aware of Feng's innocence, Yang resolves to help him escape from prison. However, their escape attempt goes awry, and both find themselves facing the grim reality of death row.

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: Feng, a homeless man, is wrongly accused of robbery and subsequently arrested and imprisoned. The actual bandit bribes fellow inmate Yang, a pickpocket, to kill Feng. Aware of Feng's innocence, Yang resolves to help him escape from prison. However, their escape attempt goes awry, and both find themselves facing the grim reality of death row.

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but have to find ways to be together and resolve the hatred between their families.

programme.title: Portrait In Crystal
programme.desc: Tragic deaths in the underworld cause leader "Yama" (Teng Wei-hao) to suspect a portrait in crystal with mysterious powers. He sends Hen Pan (Chen Hung) and Pai Pan (Hung Hsin-nan) to interrogate its creator, martial artist Lung Fei (Pai Piao)...

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Killer Darts
programme.desc: A group of bandits raided the village where dart master Liu lives and killed his wife. While hunting them down, Liu's disciple kills a farmer and his wife when she refuses his advances, leading Liu to adopt their orphaned daughter and raises her with his son. Years later, the daughter meets a man with the bandits and is tricked to go against Liu.

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A man joins the Hong Kong police force to track down a murderer who has killed his friend in a robbery. While he struggles to reconcile his law defending police duty with his desire for vengeance, he also has a new-found respect for the law.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiance so as to drive away two women whom he does not like...

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Tie Zhong Tang, adopted son of Da Chi Men leader Yun Yi, is hunted by rival Situ Xiao, who seeks the clan's hidden treasure. To uncover its secrets, Tie journeys to Changchun Island to find the legendary "Ri Hou". Instead, he finds "Ri Hou" dead and discovers the clan's founder, "Ye Di" Tie Yi, is his real father.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: Three young men offend a billionaire and are drawn into a high stakes bet. If they win, they get to keep the billionaire's Rolls Royce. Otherwise, they will need to pay the rich man fifty thousand dollars! Will the underdogs win the bet?

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Empress Dowager. She orders the Reformists to be arrested and Wang Wu gets drawn into the politics.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: The Kid with the Golden Arm
programme.desc: The government hires Yang to escort a cargo of gold to a famine stricken area. The vicious Chi Sha gang, with one of their best fighters, Golden Arm, announce their intention to hijack it by killing one of Yang's employees. As Yang gathers his own team of reputable fighters to protect his cargo, are they strong enough to hold off Golden Arm?

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Murder Plot
programme.desc: Martial artist Shen Lang is in discussions with kung fu experts from the other six sects to plot the downfall of the traitorous Happy King when his fiancee suddenly disrupts them and Shen has to quickly bring her away. As they continue to pursue the Happy King, both Shen and his fiancee accidentally fall into a trap set up by the King.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats
programme.desc: Nan Tou Kuan, a spoiled but talented young heir from Guangdong, is sent to Beijing by his mother to find a bride and mature. Along the way, he befriends three rogues: a cardsharp, a ladies' man, and a master thief. Together, they must outwit the sinister Three-Eyed Taoist, who plots to seize the family's fortune.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: There's no place like home.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return...

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon could be called "Swordswomen Two." Three decades earlier, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu took on Shaw's first international superstar, Lo Lieh for the Han Family Sword - making this a four-star treat for action fans.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: The young Chen Chi-chin (Liu Yung) loses heavily to experienced gambler Hu Kuan-ten (Lo Lieh). His father loses at cards and dies of shock. Chen appeals to his uncle who summons seven fellow professional gamblers to carry out vengeance. Much more than a gambling film, this is a thrilling melting pot of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, poker-face vengeance, and all sorts of edge-of-your-seat gambling duels. Featuring two of the leading action stars of the era, Chen Kuen-tai and Lo Lie

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Hua, a clever beauty, teams up with her brother to stage a jewel heist and plans to sell the loot in Singapore. To evade customs, she slips a diamond ring into the pocket of a fellow passenger, Zhang Zhi Xian, only to lose him after landing. Forced to track him down, Hua resorts to a series of clumsy schemes to get close and retrieve the ring.

programme.title: The Black Lizard
programme.desc: Young swordsman Lung Fei encounters strange omens portending the death of his fiance. His enquiries with the help of Chief Constable Tieh Hu reveal an astounding story, in this tale of men and women struggling to save their true loves.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: Aptly described by its original title of "Money, Sex And Love", this is a gripping drama about Judy, a woman with a rich husband as well as two lovers who happen to be brothers. Jenny Hu is Judy, and her knockout beauty makes this summer sizzle...

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: Two feuding princes fight for the throne in the Qing Dynasty, causing many injuries and deaths to the commoners. Can the lady assassin who is drawn into this royal feud execute her assassination mission in time to help one of the princes secure the throne?

programme.title: The Mad Monk (1977)
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: Masked Avengers
programme.desc: A mysterious new gang, the Masked Avengers, is slaughtering the martial world's greatest heroes. To stop them, three fearless fighters must track down the gang's hidden lair in Jingyang Town and put an end to their reign of terror.

programme.title: Masked Avengers
programme.desc: A mysterious new gang, the Masked Avengers, is slaughtering the martial world's greatest heroes. To stop them, three fearless fighters must track down the gang's hidden lair in Jingyang Town and put an end to their reign of terror.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers
programme.desc: Hu seeks to avenge his father who is being killed by the White-Browed Hermit and his gang. However, he fails in his attempt and is saved by Fang Shi Yu, a youth from Shaolin whose parents are also killed by the same villains. They learn and master the advanced Shaolin style kung fu, before Fang leads Hu and the Shaolin fellows to fight the enemies.

programme.title: The Naval Commandos
programme.desc: The Chinese Navy is attempting to defend its coastline from a Japanese attack, they send their commando unit led by Cui Hsia into the mainland to enlist help to thwart the Japanese before they attack. The commandos enlist the help of Song San and Shiao Liu to kill the Japanese officers led by Shan Mao and destroy their attacking ships.

programme.title: The Battle Wizard
programme.desc: Dali Prince Tuan Yu knows nothing about martial arts, but leaves the palace for the martial arts world. He meets a snake sorceress and his mysterious half-sister. Through various misadventures, Tuan Yu gains invincible power by sucking the cobra's blood and swallowing the magic toad, eventually defeating his father's old rival.

programme.title: The Thundering Sword
programme.desc: Two disciples, Yu and Zheng, are sent by their master to track down the invincible weapon "Thundering Sword" to prevent villains from getting it. Yu encounters the daughter of a ruthless clan, Chiao, who is on her way to seek for the sword. They quickly fall for each other, but when Chiao accidentally injures Zheng, things become complicated.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical "Lucky Casino" and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: 7-Man Army
programme.desc: In 1933, during the defence of the Great Wall at Gubeikou, seven Chinese soldiers are separated from their main force and tasked with defending the strategic outpost of Badaolouzi. Vastly outnumbered by Japanese troops and tanks, they make a last stand, fighting to the end in a powerful display of sacrifice and patriotism.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: My Rebellious Son
programme.desc: A corrupt official attempts to steal a priceless Buddha statue from a temple to please a group of Westerners. Luckily, Doctor Zhang and his son manage to defeat the Western boxers, the Japanese Kendo opponents and the Western longsword fighters with Chinese kung fu, thus saving the Buddha statue.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: The Jade Faced Assassin
programme.desc: Two forbidden lovers, Zhang Zhen and Yue Nu, are killed by four villains and left behind their twin babies. Yue Nu's elder sister hopes to restore the clan's honour and separates the twins, arranging for them to be raised by competing clans. 18 years later, the twins meet and fight against each other, bringing chaos to the martial arts world.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: Finger of Doom
programme.desc: The protagonists are ex-swordmasters who now find joy in making umbrellas. They track down the evil Madame Kung Sun and her poisonous "Finger of Doom", a unique supernatural power which allows her to transform normal, everyday people into horrifying zombies, and this is just the start of their mythical adventure against this zombie maker!

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: Martial Club
programme.desc: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liang's masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: Zhao Bu Fan is the sergeant of the government's secret police. Wang is a cruel and ruthless eunuch who takes over the Emperor's ruling power and leads the team of secret agents. After witnessing the atrocities committed by Eunuch Wang, Sergeant Zhao decides to defect but ends up being hunted by his friends, comrades and even his father.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This joyous, raucous, & colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: The Tigress Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Sam is being hunted as he discovers that the mayor and the chief of medical bureau are colluding with a drug dealer. He is saved by a fishermen family and works in their friend's grocery but the grocery owner is killed when the enemies track Sam down. Sam escapes to Shaolin to learn the cudgel style of kung fu in order to avenge his friends.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her...

programme.title: Murderer Pursues
programme.desc: Wang Chung was a valued actor long before he became a director, but as a filmmaker, he helped create some of the most interesting thrillers Shaw Brothers ever released - including this fascinating crime saga of a Sino-Vietnamese crime gang. Danny Lee stars as a misunderstood refugee while Ray Lui plays a cop struggling against his own conscience to ensure that justice is upheld.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Linda's tragic suicide.

programme.title: Oath Of Death
programme.desc: Three Sung loyalists become blood brothers to fight the tyranny of the Tartar invaders. To oust the oppressors altogether, Ma releases the kidnapped Tartar princess in a strategic effort to gain points with the invaders, but it soon becomes apparent that he desires both a great position and power, and will do anything to get it...

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: Killer Constable
programme.desc: Kuei Chih-hung was famous for his modern day crime thrillers, his horror flicks, and even his comedies. But if the only kung-fu film he ever made was this one, he'd still be spoken of with respect by even the most ardent martial arts movie fan. Many consider this real life martial arts champion Chen Kuan-tai's best performance. As a deeply, even obsessively, dedicated Chief Court Constable, he illuminates the screen with fighting skill and emotional passion. Award winning actor Ku Feng is his eq

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancee Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wang's friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolin's Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hung's son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents' kung fu styles.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: The Magnificent Swordsman centres on the hero who vows vengeance against evil bandits who killed his family when he was a child. The hero recruits several friends to help the peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader of the band being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: Shadow Girl
programme.desc: A young swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night after taking her grandma's pill. She ruined the wedding of a bandit chief's daughter using her powers and is hunted down by them for revenge. Will she escape the hunt?

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: Sima works for a corrupt lord Qin who is suffering from a deadly disease that only a special herb can cure. Qin sends him on an urgent mission to retrieve it, but the task is made more difficult when Sima has to fight off other martial artists who want to steal the cure away from him. He has to fight with his ultimate weapon, the Dragon Missile!

programme.title: The Fighting Fool
programme.desc: Famous Kung Fu Pole master Red Eagle, is kidnapped by a villain one day. His disciple Meng, vows to rescue him. On his way, Meng encounters a greedy but great martial artist who agrees to join him in the rescue. Even though the two have extremely different personalities, they manage to team up and fight the villain in a final showdown.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Fu Hong Xue, a legendary swordsman, travels far to avenge his father, only to find the seven killers he tracks are already dead. Investigating with Yeh Kai, he learns they are alive, manipulated by disguise master Xiao Bie Li, who lures Fu into a trap. Yeh Kai aids him, but both end up trapped in a deadly blade formation.

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber (1961)
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh's looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet "Classic Beauty".

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: Guided by mysterious dreams, archaeologist Jack discovers he was General Meng Yi in a past life and shared a tragic love with Princess Ok-Soo that spanned a thousand years. When they reunite in Emperor Qin's celestial palace, a ruthless tycoon seeks the secret of immortality. Reclaiming his past strength, Jack faces a final battle of destiny.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs III
programme.desc: Ming is transferred to do menial police work ten months after the murder of Yan, in 2004. Meanwhile, a new star, Wing, has emerged in the police force and Ming suspects he is also a mole sent by the triad. Determined to start anew, Ming must kill Wing while ensuring his own identity does not get exposed.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: God of Gamblers 2
programme.desc: After the God of Gamblers Ko Chun disappears, his disciple Little Knife rises in the gambling world. His fame attracts a ruthless rival who seeks to defeat him. Facing high-stakes games, Little Knife must rely on his skills to overcome his enemies and defend the honour of the God of Gamblers.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip’s boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim’s sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist’s drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: The Mad Monk (1993)
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: After his father's death, the impoverished Kwan moves to the provincial capital and works at a textile workshop run by his late father's friend, retired martial artist Tuen. As a ruthless Manchu warlord exploits martial arts tournaments to expand his criminal influence, Kwan and his allies become entangled in a dangerous fight for justice.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur…

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Hail the Judge
programme.desc: A low level magistrate is run out of town for defending a beautiful murder suspect. Through a series of comedic events he ascends to the top rank & returns looking for revenge.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian’s daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond…

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi’s husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon

While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...
